name: radio-group
title: Radio Group
summary: Pick exactly one of a short list of options, all visible at once.
description: Pick exactly one of a short list of options, all visible at once. Each option is a 16px round control on a hairline ring whose inset ring grows into a 5px ink ring when selected, so the 6px on-ink centre forms as the ring closes in. Stacked or in a row. It is one tab stop: arrow keys move and select. Behaviour comes from the Zag radio-group machine, through Ark UI in React, Vue and Svelte. Visually hidden native radios carry focus, arrow keys and the form value.

anatomy.description: role=radiogroup; data-orientation=vertical|horizontal; data-disabled Wrapper rule: class and style land on this outermost element (what a caller sizes and places); every other attribute stays on the control.
Visible group label; names the group
Row layout only: the list's one gliding highlight (`glideLayer` of `lib/glide.ts`, aria-hidden); it follows the pointer and keyboard focus.
One option and its hit area; data-state=checked|unchecked, data-focus-visible, data-disabled. In row layout it composes the shared option row (`lib/option.ts`).
The 16px round control (aria-hidden); one inset ring draws both states (no dot element); carries kbd-instant
The option's text and accessible name
Native radio, visually hidden: focus, arrow keys and form value
Row layout only: the free-text row ("Something else") after the options, in the same list; it composes the shared option row (`lib/option.ts`).
The free-text field: type=text, named by aria-label. Typing clears the selection; picking an option clears it.

items.description: Options in order. Strings are accepted as value = label.

value.description: Selected value, or null for none.

label.description: Visible group label; otherwise pass aria-label.

orientation.description: vertical: stacked options. horizontal: options in a row that wraps.

layout.description: inline: each control with its label, sized to the text. row: a list; each option fills a 30px option row (`lib/option.ts`) under one gliding highlight, stacked whatever the orientation; the control is drawn the same.

name.description: Form field name of the radios.

customPlaceholder.description: Row layout: adds the free-text row after the options with this placeholder (e.g. "Something else…").

customLabel.description: Accessible name of the free-text field; defaults to the placeholder.

customEnterKeyHint.description: enterkeyhint of the free-text field: the label of the Enter key on a phone keyboard ("next" when another step follows).

custom.description: Text of the free-text row. Typing makes the value null; picking an option makes it empty.

keyboard: Tab reaches the selected option (or the first, when none is selected); the group is one tab stop
ArrowDown / ArrowRight select the next enabled option, ArrowUp / ArrowLeft the previous; they wrap
Home / End select the first / last enabled option
Row layout: Tab from the group reaches the free-text field, which keeps Home / End for its text
notes: Give the group a visible label or an aria-label.
Disabled options are skipped by the arrow keys.
To select from outside, control `value` (null clears): React value / onValueChange, Vue v-model:value, Svelte bind:value.

motion: select: one property, the inset ring, grows from 1.5px line-strong to 5px ink over duration.base with easing.out-strong, so the on-ink centre forms as the ring closes in
deselect: the ring runs back over duration.fast; when the selection moves, the old option empties while the new one fills, both from the same moment
press (pointer only): the control scales to motion.press-scale-sm over duration.press with easing.out-strong
keyboard (arrows, Space, Home, End): instant; every control carries kbd-instant and the label colour is instant too
mount: nothing animates on the first paint, in every target
reduced motion: the ring keeps its width and only changes colour over duration.fast; the press stays

row layout: one glide highlight (`glideLayer` of `lib/glide.ts`) travels to the hovered or focused row (duration.move, easing.out-strong; first appearance fades in); press darkens the row (hover-2) and scales the control as above
